result.markdown:
For most small support teams, **Freshdesk is the best all-around help desk software**\. It offers a good balance of ticket management, automation, reporting, integrations, and room to grow without the complexity of an enterprise platform.

However, the best choice depends on how your team handles customer requests.

Here are my top recommendations for 2026.

## Best help desk software compared

Pricing is indicative US list pricing; annual billing where noted. Verify current plans before purchasing.

| Software | Best for | Starting price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Freshdesk** | Best overall | \$19/agent/mo |
| **Help Scout** | Email-first support | Free; paid from \$25/user/mo |
| **Zoho Desk** | Tight budgets | Free; paid from \$7/user/mo |
| **Zendesk** | More advanced support | \$19/agent/mo |
| **Intercom** | Live chat and AI | \$29/seat/mo |
| **HubSpot Service Hub** | Existing HubSpot users | Free; paid from \$20/seat/mo |
